description: This Java source file defines the ProductDisplayWorker class, which provides static utility methods for retrieving and processing product shopping cart data in an e-commerce system built with OFBiz. The methods include fetching related or recommended products, handling reorder logic, and ordering products based on custom ranking maps.

classes.name: ProductDisplayWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for retrieving related products, reorder suggestions, and ordered product lists based on custom metrics within an OFBiz-based e-commerce application.

methods.name: getRandomCartProductAssoc
methods.description: Retrieves a random list of associated products (like complements or cross-sells) related to products in the current shopping cart, optionally filtered by view allowance category, with a maximum of 3 products.

methods.name: getQuickReorderProducts
methods.description: Compiles and returns a list of products frequently reordered by the current user, ranked by average quantities ordered, excluding items already in the cart, optionally filtered by category.

methods.name: productOrderByMap
methods.description: Sorts a list of products based on a provided map of ranking scores, in ascending or descending order.
